verdict: Baxter's sales rose 5% to $2.98B with growth in every segment, and a $253M gain from buying back its own debt below face value lifted net income to $294M (EPS $0.57).

kpis.label: EPS (diluted)
kpis.note: Vs a loss a year ago

kpis.label: Debt buyback gain
kpis.note: From repurchasing bonds at a discount

segments.name: Medical Products & Therapies
segments.note: IV solutions, infusion systems, drug compounding, injectable drugs (the former Pharmaceuticals segment) and advanced surgery products.

segments.name: Healthcare Systems & Technologies
segments.note: Hospital beds, patient monitors and connected-care software.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Manufacturing supply sales to Vantive, the kidney-care business Baxter separated in 2025.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: As reported, SG&A was $730M; it is shown net of $86M of other operating income (mostly transition-services income from Vantive, plus a patent settlement benefit) so the flow balances.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing new medical devices and drug products.

otherDetail: A $253M gain on early extinguishment of debt — Baxter repurchased its bonds below face value — less $61M of net interest expense.

takeaways.title: Sales rose to $2.98B
takeaways.text: Both main segments grew: Medical Products & Therapies +6% on infusion strength, Healthcare Systems & Technologies +4%.

takeaways.title: A gain from its own debt
takeaways.text: With its bonds trading at a discount, Baxter bought debt back early and booked a $253M gain — the main reason net income swung from a $46M loss a year ago to a $294M profit.

takeaways.title: EPS of $0.57
takeaways.text: Adjusted results strip out the debt gain and $95M of intangible amortization among other items; the underlying business grew steadily rather than spectacularly.

footerNote: Net income from continuing operations ($298M) is shown; total net income was $294M after a $4M loss from discontinued operations. SG&A is shown net of $86M of other operating income, as explained in its note.
